verdict.headline: Go bodyboarding: Lagide Lunch — 13:00
verdict.reason: Lagide looks like the best bodyboard option for lunch — 13:00.  This should feel like a fun progression session rather than a heavy one.  The wind should be manageable, but not a big advantage.  The tide should help the reef hold shape.

conversationalSummary.text: GO for bodyboarding today, with Lagide lining up nicely around lunch (about 13:00). Surfline looks fair and the wind is mixed but still workable, so the conditions should be usable rather than a slog. There’s a good window as the tide is mid and dropping, which should help turn the size into longer, more rideable walls. I’d check the Surfline cams and MEO Beachcam before heading out to confirm it’s as clean as it looks on the forecast.

best.explanation: Lagide looks like a fun-sized window for Fun progression, High confidence: 0.9-1.2 m, 175 kJ, 10 s period, consistent 70/100, and wind is not fully clear.  A dependable left-hand reef that turns modest swell into real rides; this is best for clean, playful walls when the bigger beaches are too wild or too small; 10-13s at mid tide suits the reef shelves and gives long workable walls.  Expect: it can get busy, and it is usually more flow than heavy barrel.
best.shortExplanation: Lagide is worth a quick check for lunch — 13:00, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  The wind should be manageable, but not a big advantage.  The tide should help the reef hold shape.

ranked.explanation: Cantinho da Baia looks like a clean fun-sized window for Safe fun, Medium confidence: 0.6-0.9 m, 191 kJ, 10 s period, consistent 67/100, and glassy conditions.  A forgiving sandy bay with lots of take-off points; this is best for easy wave count and cleaner faces when the north wind is bothering exposed beaches.  Watch: 10-13s at high tide can get fat and slow in the sheltered bay.
ranked.shortExplanation: Cantinho da Baia is worth a quick check for mid-morning — 11:00, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  The wind should help keep it tidy.  The tide helps a bit, but the bay still needs enough push.

ranked.explanation: Meio da Baia looks like a clean solid window for Worth checking, Medium confidence: 1.2-1.5 m, 264 kJ, 10 s period, consistent 67/100, and glassy conditions.  An inconsistent Baía spot that can work well when north-northwest swell reaches the bay; this is best for bodyboard sessions when the bay is clean, there is enough period and size, and the forecast shows a defined wave.  Expect: it is less reliable than the main bay spots, so weak swell or short period can make it feel soft.

A sheltered beachbreak with gentle lefts and rights, somewhat similar to Cantinho but less consistent; this is best for manageable bodyboard waves when north-northwest swell reaches the bay with clean southerly wind.  Expect: it can feel softer or less defined than the main peaks, and rocks may appear closer to the west cliffs.
